bursaries.facilitator: Free State Premier / provincial bursary process
bursaries.fields: Scarce and critical skills as listed by the Free State Provincial Government
bursaries.coverage: Provincial study bursary (confirm package on advert)
documents: Proof of Free State residence where required
bursaries.notes: Closes very soon (13 Nov 2026). Confirm the latest advert and submission address on the Free State government / bursary notice before applying.

bursaries.fields: Mining and minerals-related qualifications at HEIs and TVET colleges
bursaries.coverage: Bursary funding support for employed bursars
documents: Proof of employment in mining/minerals sector
bursaries.notes: For applicants currently employed in the mining and minerals sector. Late applications are not considered. Apply on the MQA SIMS link.

bursaries.programme: MQA Unemployed Bursaries 2027 (via public universities & TVET)
bursaries.facilitator: Institution applies on MQA OneView on behalf of students
bursaries.fields: Mining and minerals-related undergraduate / TVET programmes
bursaries.coverage: Institution-nominated bursary support
documents: Contact your university / UoT / TVET financial aid or MQA liaison
ID and academic records for institutional nomination
Financial-need documents as required by the institution
bursaries.notes: Public universities, universities of technology and TVET colleges apply on behalf of deserving students via MQA OneView. Ask your campus bursary office urgently — closes 19 Nov 2026.

bursaries.fields: English and related undergraduate studies (confirm faculty notice)
bursaries.coverage: Scholarship support for English studies
documents: Application as directed by your English department / noticeboard
bursaries.notes: Often administered via university English departments. Check your campus noticeboard or faculty office for the 2027 form and submission route.

bursaries.programme: Bradshaw LeRoux Bursary 2027 (students with a disability)
bursaries.fields: STEM, Supply Chain, IT, BCom (not Finance/Accounting), Marketing, Law, Communications, HR (preference psychology)
bursaries.coverage: 2027 academic year bursary + Potentia Career Readiness Programme
documents: CV with study plans (institution, degree, expected completion year)
Matric students: Grade 12 results + proof of application/acceptance for 2027 degree study
bursaries.notes: For students with a disability. Laptop/PC and internet needed for the Potentia programme. Email office@bradshawleroux.co.za or apply via bradshawleroux.co.za.

bursaries.sponsor: Institute for Landscape Architecture in South Africa (ILASA)
bursaries.fields: Landscape architecture / built environment (confirm ILASA advert)
bursaries.coverage: ILASA study bursary
bursaries.notes: Confirm the current application form and email on the ILASA website or studentbursaries listing before the 27 Nov cut-off.

bursaries.facilitator: Online Xylem SA Trust bursary application (GrowZA)
bursaries.fields: Civil / Environmental / Electrical / Mechanical Engineering; Water Science; Sanitation; Hydrology; Environmental Health; relevant TVET
bursaries.coverage: Bursary for Black students in water/engineering/science fields
documents: Documents prompted on the GrowZA / Xylem form
bursaries.notes: Queries: bursaries@growza.co.za. Prefer Black applicants in water, engineering and applied science fields.

bursaries.fields: University studies (2nd year and onwards only)
bursaries.coverage: Tuition up to R35,000 paid to the institution (1 year; renewal on progress)
documents: Two non-family referees (one from current university)
bursaries.notes: 2nd-year and onwards students only. Email completed form to info@bakwena.co.za. Form notes a contract if awarded.

bursaries.fields: Boston City Campus undergraduate programmes
bursaries.coverage: Boston study bursary (confirm package with Boston)
documents: Any supporting docs listed by Boston
bursaries.notes: Institution-specific. Apply via Boston City Campus bursary/admissions channels before 30 Nov 2026.

bursaries.fields: Engineering (civil and related — confirm advert)
bursaries.coverage: Engineering bursary (confirm coverage on BVi notice)
bursaries.notes: Confirm the current apply email or portal on the BVi careers / bursary notice before submitting.

bursaries.programme: Dr JS Moroka Local Municipality Bursary 2027
bursaries.fields: Scarce skills and programmes listed by the municipality
bursaries.coverage: Municipal study bursary
documents: Proof of residence in Dr JS Moroka area (typical)
bursaries.notes: Usually prioritises local residents. Collect/submit via municipal offices and confirm the 2027 advert requirements.

bursaries.facilitator: Download form → deliver to municipal offices
bursaries.fields: Human & Social Sciences; Science & Technology; Technical skills (Electrical/Civil/Chemical Eng); other scarce skills per ELM needs
bursaries.coverage: Registration, tuition, books, laptop; accommodation & food for selected students
documents: Proof of residence / need docs as on the form
bursaries.notes: Forms also available at Emfuleni offices and public libraries (07:45–16:15). Deliver to Corner Klasie Havenga & Frikkie Meyer Blvd, Box 3, Vanderbijlpark 1900. Queries: MarthaM@emfuleni.gov.za / Mayorsoffice@emfuleni.gov.za.

bursaries.fields: Engineering, Computer Science / IT, Science, Construction & Built Environment, related TVET
bursaries.coverage: Water-utility related study bursary
documents: Silulumanzi application form (collect at Customer Care Offices)
Supporting docs listed on the form
bursaries.notes: Collect forms at Silulumanzi Customer Care Offices and follow submission instructions on the 2027 advert.

bursaries.sponsor: Sishen Iron Ore Company Community Development Trust
bursaries.fields: Accounting, Agriculture, Commerce, IT, Built Environment, Economics, Education, Engineering, Humanities, Law, Management, Medical and more
bursaries.coverage: Community-trust bursary (often area-linked — confirm criteria)
documents: Proof of residence if community criteria apply
bursaries.notes: Apply via the SIOC-CDT online apply link. Check beneficiary-community rules on the trust site.

bursaries.facilitator: CUBL / SUFO online portal (after SU offer)
bursaries.fields: Undergraduate programmes at Stellenbosch University
bursaries.level: Undergraduate (prospective SU students with an offer)
bursaries.coverage: Mostly partial-cost SU bursaries (need + merit)
documents: Conditional or final SU undergraduate offer accepted
Online SUFO application (ID or passport login)
Financial-need and academic documents as prompted
bursaries.notes: Only for students who accepted a Stellenbosch undergraduate offer. Late applications not accepted. NSFAS 2027 already closed (31 Oct).

bursaries.sponsor: Department of Basic Education / Funza Lushaka
bursaries.fields: Bachelor of Education / teaching qualifications (priority subjects)
bursaries.coverage: Tuition, accommodation or transport, meals, learning materials, personal care, teaching practice support
documents: Academic progress / registration details as prompted
bursaries.notes: Returning bursars only for this deadline. First-time Funza applicants close 31 January 2027 — see separate listing.

bursaries.sponsor: South African Council for the Architectural Profession
bursaries.fields: Architecture / architectural profession pathways
bursaries.coverage: SACAP architectural study bursary
bursaries.notes: Confirm form and submission details on the SACAP website before 4 Dec 2026.

bursaries.sponsor: Department of Basic Education / Funza Lushaka
bursaries.fields: Initial teacher education (BEd) — priority teaching subjects
bursaries.coverage: Tuition, accommodation or transport, meals, learning materials, personal care, teaching practice
documents: Select Funza Lushaka Bursary Scheme → 2027 application
bursaries.notes: Still open with a later deadline than returning bursars. Teaching service obligation applies. Apply only via e-Gov — not agents.

bursaries.fields: Multiple — engineering, commerce, science, mining & more per listing
bursaries.coverage: Varies by sponsoring employer
bursaries.notes: Rolling facilitator platform — browse open undergraduate listings and apply inside Career Wise.

bursaries.fields: All fields (crowdfunding support)
bursaries.coverage: Crowd-funded support toward fees / study costs
bursaries.notes: Not a traditional bursary — fundraising platform listed on UCT DSA noticeboard. Useful if other windows have closed.
